subject.title: [Feature]: Disable image optimization when images are uploaded to Slack

question: Should Slack media delivery honor the existing forceDocument/asDocument raw-upload contract, add a separate default-off Slack upload-fidelity setting, or keep the current optimizing pipeline as the supported behavior?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior affects Slack delivery semantics, config/API surface, and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Honor Per-Call Fidelity
options.body: Wire Slack uploads so forceDocument/asDocument disables image optimization for explicit file/media sends while keeping current defaults unchanged.

options.title: Add Default-Off Slack Setting
options.body: Add a Slack-owned account/channel setting for raw uploads with clear per-call override semantics, docs, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Keep the optimizing media pipeline as Slack's supported default and document when original bytes are or are not preserved.

recommendation.title: Honor Per-Call Fidelity
recommendation.body: Wire Slack uploads so forceDocument/asDocument disables image optimization for explicit file/media sends while keeping current defaults unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history spans shared media loading, Slack delivery, and config compatibility.
